name: ShenZhen QiangRui Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ShenZhen QiangRui Precision Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sales of tooling and testing fixtures and equipment in China. The company offers laser welding tool, pressure maintenance tool, pressing clamp tool, battery liquid cooling test tray, and chip testing socket; and liquid-cooled cabinet measurement test equipment, liquid-cooled server CDU, quadrupole mass spectrometry instrument, camera image stabilization testing equipment, and intelligent driving solutions.
